title: Cube image with the model
description: Adds a Dockerfile that copies cube/ into Cube's image and runs it as the unprivileged node user, and the image task, which tags the image with the Cube version and a hash of the data model, so an unchanged model is never built, pushed or rolled out again, and pushes it for amd64 and arm64 to GitHub's registry or CUBE_IMAGE. Self-hosted Cube Core only.

context_before: After an intended change, `mise run check --update` rewrites the snapshots, so the pull request shows reviewers how the SQL behind each metric changes. Give every metric something depends on a golden query, with absolute date ranges so its SQL stays the same from day to day.
added: `mise run image` builds the image every environment runs: Cube's own image with `cube/` copied into `/cube/conf`. Its tag is the Cube version followed by a hash of the data model, so one model always has one tag, and an unchanged model is never built, pushed or rolled out again. `mise run image --push` builds it for amd64 and arm64 and pushes it to `ghcr.io/<owner>/<repo>`, or to the repository `CUBE_IMAGE` names.

content: # The image needs the Cube project only, without the dev server's local data.
# Cube with this project's data model and configuration in /cube/conf: the
# image every environment runs, built and tagged by `mise run image`. Keep
# CUBE_VERSION on the release compose.yaml runs.
# Python or npm packages that cube.py or the model import install here, before
# the switch to the unprivileged user:
# The `node` user of the base image; the chart runs the pods as its uid, 1000.
#MISE description="Build the Cube image that holds the data model, tagged by its content"
# Builds Dockerfile, which copies cube/ into Cube's image, and prints the
# image's reference. The tag is the Cube version followed by a hash of what the
# image holds (cube/, Dockerfile and .dockerignore), so one data model always
# has one tag: an unchanged model is never built, pushed or rolled out again.
#   --load   build into the local Docker engine (the default)
#   --push   build for linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 and push to the registry,
#            unless it has the tag already; log in to the registry first
# CUBE_IMAGE names the repository. It defaults to ghcr.io/<owner>/<repo> for a
for a local build without one.
hash=$(git ls-files --cached --others --exclude-standard -- cube Dockerfile .dockerignore | LC_ALL=C sort |
echo "error: set CUBE_IMAGE to the repository to push the image to" >&2
if docker buildx imagetools inspect "$ref" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
echo "$ref is in the registry already" >&2
